issues.followupFix: Connection, Host, DeviceProfile, Service and UDP state share a bounded encoded cache with private SQLite backing; default CLI cache is 32 MiB, at most 4096 entries, plus a separate 1 MiB SQLite page cache. Ports, SNI counters, profile labels, contacts, service-flow membership and deferred-DPI samples use normalized rows. UDP datagrams are streamed in capture-time order through all 10 eligible stream readers; raw bytes, reply-first roles, directional evidence and capture metadata are retained. Evidence spans are spooled instead of accumulated. Tiny-cache audit equivalence, native DPI, tuple generations, snapshots, late updates, ARP/DHCP binding, ambiguous-IP lookup, discovery updates, stale snapshot isolation, identity seeding, sample caps, failure cancellation and cleanup are tested. Service probe callbacks run outside the aggregate lock
